# Imposia 0.6.0

Imposia 0.6.0 paginates business documents the way they are written: invoices,
statements, reports, and agreements with styled page furniture, per-document
page numbers, grids with spanning items, and table rows longer than a page. Long
documents stay fast, and printing matches the preview more closely.

**This release contains four breaking changes.** Read
[the migration note](https://github.com/EungyuCho/imposia/blob/main/docs/migrations/0.6.0.md)
before upgrading. Most applications need no code change, but printed output,
exhaustive `switch` statements over the React status unions, and imports of the
removed PDF viewer can be affected. The note also lists the layout changes that
can change a page count or a warning list without a code change.

## Breaking

- Printing preserves backgrounds by default (`print-color-adjust: exact`).
- Printing renames every hoisted `@font-face` family to
  `imposia-print-<n>--<family>`, so host fonts can no longer fill in for faces
  the composed document never loaded.
- `ImposiaDocumentStatus` and `ImposiaPublicationStatus` gained `"aborted"`.
- `mountViewer` and the `pdfjs-dist` dependency were removed from
  `@imposia/viewer`, `@imposia/client`, and `@imposia/react`.

## Highlights

- **Page furniture.** All sixteen `@page` margin boxes; font, color, alignment,
  border, and padding declarations in them; top and bottom boxes sized to their
  content; `@page :nth(An+B)`; and the `A3`, `A5`, `B4`, `B5`, `Legal`, and
  `Ledger` page sizes.
- **Per-document page numbers.** `PublicationOptions.pageNumbering: "entry"`
  starts every entry on a new page and numbers it on its own, so a batch of
  invoices prints "Page 1 of 2" on each invoice.
- **Tables and grids.** A table row taller than a page is split cell by cell
  instead of being clipped. Grids with `grid-column: span N` or `1 / -1` break
  between complete rows.
- **Fewer, truer warnings.** `UNSUPPORTED_LAYOUT` fires only when keeping a
  layout whole costs content. An ordinary row of `display: flex` cards no
  longer warns.
- **Right-to-left text.** A `dir="rtl"` on the source `<html>` or `<body>` is
  kept, and a right-to-left document warns that page progression stays left to
  right.
- **Long documents.** Pagination stays linear in document length: a 1,800-page
  mount dropped from 13.9 s to 1.6 s, and 10,000 pages mount in about 12 s.
  Preparation and commit work yield to the host. Hosts can raise
  `maxInputBytes`, `maxNodes`, `maxPages`, and `resourceDeadlineMs` up to fixed
  maximums (ADR 0015).
- **Assets.** Legacy font MIME spellings are accepted, `RESOURCE_BLOCKED` is
  reported per resource without leaking URLs, and `@font-face` lists collapse to
  their woff2 candidate.
- **Playground.** The hosted demo is now the
  [Imposia Playground](https://imposia.pages.dev/examples/demo/): five business
  documents with live data, page setup, and Print / Save as PDF.

## Removed escape hatches

`experimental.forceSequentialPlacement`, `experimental.forceLegacyLineEnds`,
and `experimental.forceFullConstraintCapture` were removed on the schedule
announced in 0.5.0. The fast paths they switched off keep their fallbacks, so
output is unchanged. See
[the `0.x` API change policy](https://github.com/EungyuCho/imposia/blob/main/docs/api-policy.md).

## Pagination integrity and measured bundle cost

- Fixed repeated fragment edges, footnote/page-float collisions, publishing CSS precedence, list continuation, page names, and avoid-break handling. Positioned visual overflow no longer creates extra pages.
- Added 183 independently authored pagination scenarios and two multi-generation update checks; unsupported inputs retain explicit diagnostics.
- Updated measured gzip sizes and budgets: Core pagination 63.2/63.5 KiB, Publication 67.4/68 KiB, Viewer 11.8/13 KiB, Client 71.8/72 KiB, React 73.6/74 KiB (size/budget).
- Fixed the first-commit iframe flash and preserved consumer iframe visibility on updates; improved documentation label contrast.

Core consumer routes have explicit gzip budgets of 63.5 KiB (PageDocument),
68 KiB (Publication), 72 KiB (Client), and 74 KiB (React). Viewer stays at
13 KiB. The full Core browser artifact is 68.3 KiB gzip, a different
measurement from the tree-shaken PageDocument route.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @imposia/react@0.6.0
```

Framework-neutral consumers can install the package that matches their layer:

```bash
pnpm add @imposia/core@0.6.0
pnpm add @imposia/viewer@0.6.0
pnpm add @imposia/client@0.6.0
```

All four packages move together. Mixing a `0.6.0` package with a `0.5.0` one is
not a supported combination.

## Packages

- [@imposia/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@imposia/core)
- [@imposia/viewer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@imposia/viewer)
- [@imposia/client](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@imposia/client)
- [@imposia/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@imposia/react)

Each attached `.tgz` is the package tarball submitted to npm. `SHA256SUMS`
records the matching GitHub Release asset checksums.
